{{Top|leg}}
The '''solar fin''' was a component of the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]], [[Star Wars (1977) 1|comic adaptation]], and [[Star Wars (radio)|radio dramatization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] the ''Tantive IV'' was damaged by a hit to the "principal solar fin" in the novel, and "main solar fin" in the comic. In the film the final shot went to the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]], and solar fins were not mentioned.
